info.name: NeoBank AI Assist
info.description:
All 18 endpoints of the multi-agent banking assistant with RAG.

1. Import this collection and NeoBank_AI_Assist.postman_environment.json.
2. Select the 'NeoBank AI Assist - Local' environment.
3. Start the API: uvicorn app.main:app --reload
4. Run the whole collection (Run collection) or send requests one by one.

[admin] requests also send X-Admin-Key. Run from the postman/ folder so file uploads find lockers_upload.md.

request.description: No key needed. Shows the live LLM provider, embedder and index size.

exec: pm.test("Status ok and index built", () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(b.indexed_chunks).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Policy question answered with RAG; check the sources array.
Must run right after 'Loan - EMI': same sessionId.

exec: pm.test("Reuses amount and rate", () => { pm.expect(b.answer).to.include("180 months"); pm.expect(b.answer).to.include("10,142.67"); });
pm.test("Escalated with case ID", () => { pm.expect(b.escalated).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.case_id).to.match(/^FRD-/); });

item.name: PII is masked in the reply

exec: pm.test("INR and masked", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currency).to.eql("INR"); pm.expect(b.account_no).to.match(/^X+\d{4}$/); });
